evidence.reason: The unsafe-metadata negative control never observes fixture file state after the CLI runs. run_case records `mutated_files` before invoking the CLI, then after it captures only records/completions/units, calls `cleanup()` (which chmods REPAIR_DROPIN back to `original_mode`), and only then asserts. A controller that chmods the 0666 drop-in to 0600 during the refusal leaves no trace: the rc/text/records/completions asserts pass, cleanup restores the original mode, and any later baseline file comparison also passes, so the write is masked. Capturing repair_files() immediately after the CLI and requiring equality with `mutated_files` before cleanup (with cleanup in finally) is the smallest fix.
